messages:
deploybot: Scheduled deploy v3.14 -> production starting in 10m. Preflight eval showed a marginal prompt-suite regression. Deploy window 23:00-02:00 UTC. /cc @anna @leo

anna: seeing a spike in summarizer hallucination on the prompt-suite. Eval delta: +8% hallucination rate on edgecases. Logs uploaded. :warning:

leo: dashboard -> https://redwood.internal/evals/38421. Can we pin the model back to the previous summarizer variant for prod only?

sara: rerun with deterministic seed + larger sample now. will post results in ~3m.

mike: EU canary already has customer reports. If regression holds we should abort and roll back.

opsbot: Canary traffic: EU 12%, NA 6%. No infra anomalies.

deploybot: deploy paused — preflight gate triggered: prompt-suite hallucination delta 0.081 > threshold 0.05. Flagging for rollback decision. :x:

julie: change window ends in 40m. If we roll back now we lose current staging validation but likely reduce customer impact.

anna: rerun complete. New snapshot: hallucination_delta: 0.042, recall_delta: -6.1, fluency_delta: +0.5. See snippet:

```
prompt-suite: {
  hallucination_delta: 0.042,
  recall_delta: -6.1,
  fluency_delta: +0.5
}
```

leo: borderline on recall. Can we do a targeted pin for the /summarize route instead of full rollback?

sara: scheduling a bisect on canary to isolate change (tokenizer vs quant vs prompt tuning). ETA 8m.

mike: if bisect is inconclusive we should prefer full rollback. We can't ship a >5pt recall drop to prod.

julie: Ops + Docs start rollback notes and customer comms anyway so we're ready. @mike can you pre-approve rollback if recall < -5%?

mike: pre-approve for rollback if recall < -5%. :thumbsup:

deploybot: bisect results: root cause traced to tokenizer tokenization change in tokenizer v1.3. Patch available as hotfix branch `hotfix/tokenizer-compat`. Recommend applying hotfix to model variant and re-run preflight.

anna: reviewed hotfix. Looks like it restores token mapping for edge spans. I'll run a quick smoke eval once deployed to canary.

sara: rolling hotfix to 20% of canary now. Starting prompt-suite quick-run.

opsbot: Monitoring: error rate stable, p95 latency unchanged. No new alarms.

deploybot: preflight re-eval results: hallucination_delta: 0.019, recall_delta: -1.2 — all within thresholds. Hotfix appears to resolve major regression. :tada:

julie: resume approved. Update release notes to mention tokenizer-compat hotfix and the rollback plan. Drafting comms and changelog.

mike: keep a close watch on EU feedback for next 2 hours. If any sign of recall degradation -> immediate pin to previous variant.

anna: will monitor logs and user reports. thanks everyone. Closing thread when rollout completes.
